title: EntityHistoryScreen
responsibility: The history screen of an entity of any kind: the commits that changed it through the shown commit.

inputs.name: EntityHistoryScreen.index
inputs.description: The Harness index is passed to EntityHistory for the selected entity's history. This screen does not inspect the index itself.

inputs.name: EntityHistoryScreen.head
inputs.description: The selected head revision is passed as the first known revision for EntityHistory. It is the only known revision when parent is null.

inputs.name: EntityHistoryScreen.parent
inputs.description: The selected head's parent revision, or null. When present it is added after head in EntityHistory's known revisions; when null, only head is passed.

inputs.name: EntityHistoryScreen.scope
inputs.description: The explorer scope is passed to EntityHistory, and scope.commit is used with entity.id as the keyed history identity. Changing either key value recreates that history subtree.

inputs.name: EntityHistoryScreen.route
inputs.description: The current explorer location is carried in host to EntityFrame. This screen does not read its fields directly.

inputs.name: EntityHistoryScreen.entities
inputs.description: The projected entity list is carried in host to EntityFrame. This screen does not inspect or filter the list.

inputs.name: EntityHistoryScreen.lens
inputs.description: The entity lens supplies the rows through history(entity.id) for the entity selected by EntityFrame. This screen calls only that history method.

inputs.name: EntityHistoryScreen.client
inputs.description: The revision client is passed to EntityHistory. This screen does not call client.revision directly.

inputs.name: EntityHistoryScreen.mediaBase
inputs.description: The media base string is carried in host to EntityFrame. This screen does not read or transform it directly.

inputs.name: EntityHistoryScreen.onroute
inputs.description: The host navigation callback is carried in host to EntityFrame. This screen does not invoke it directly.

outputs.name: EntityHistoryScreen.entityHistory
outputs.description: Markup renders EntityFrame around the selected entity's EntityHistory. Rows come from lens.history(entity.id), and the history subtree is keyed by entity.id plus scope.commit.
